items.title: Boston opened an RFP to operate and modernize its coordinated street-furniture program
items.business: City of Boston Property Management Department
items.description: The City of Boston is requesting proposals for a contractor to manage, maintain, expand and modernize its advertising-supported Coordinated Street Furniture Program. The scope includes bus shelters, public toilets, information panels, digital displays, benches and related public-realm amenities. Proposals are due November 4, 2026 at 12:00 p.m. Boston time.
why: Multi-asset program combines physical infrastructure, digital information and ongoing operations

items.title: Hopkinton is seeking a vendor for a mental-health awareness and stigma-reduction media campaign
items.business: Town of Hopkinton Youth & Family Services
items.description: Hopkinton Youth & Family Services issued an open solicitation for a multimodal Mental Health Awareness Training public-awareness and stigma-reduction campaign. Public solicitation details call for campaign strategy and branding, messaging, digital and social assets, web graphics, print collateral, and editable source files/templates. Responses are due September 14, 2026. This is an explicit procurement opportunity.
why: Defined digital, social, web and print communications scope
items.sourceName: Town of Hopkinton / COMMBUYS listing via HigherGov

items.title: UMass opened an enterprise master-data-management platform and implementation RFP
items.description: The University of Massachusetts issued RFP UMass-2027-1124 for a SaaS Master Data Management platform and implementation services to modernize enterprise identity mastering across the university system. Public bid documents describe identity reconciliation, identifier management, affiliation lifecycle management, integrations, governance and future master-data expansion. Proposals are due September 23, 2026.
why: Enterprise multi-campus software and implementation scope
items.sourceName: University of Massachusetts public bid listing / PublicBidSearch

items.title: Boston is seeking a vendor to develop a water-utilities registered apprenticeship program
items.business: City of Boston Office of Workforce Development
items.description: The City of Boston Office of Workforce Development is requesting proposals from a qualified vendor to support development of a comprehensive Registered Apprenticeship Program for high-demand technical positions involving heavy equipment and utility infrastructure. Proposals are due September 25, 2026 at 2:00 p.m. Boston time.
why: Defined workforce-development scope for utility and heavy-equipment occupations

items.title: Foxborough, Plainville and Wrentham are seeking a three-year marketing and tourism consultant
items.business: Towns of Foxborough, Plainville and Wrentham
items.description: The Town of Foxborough, in partnership with Plainville and Wrentham, has an active RFP for experienced firms to provide marketing, media-relations and tourism consulting services under a three-year contract. Proposals are due September 17, 2026 at 9:00 a.m. The Town requires interested parties to register to access the procurement documents.
why: Official municipal procurement page lists the RFP as active

items.title: Community Teamwork is actively bidding 24/7 security services for Lowell shelter sites
items.description: Community Teamwork is publicly requesting bids from qualified security-service vendors to provide 24/7 security support for up to two shelter sites in Lowell. Bids are due September 11 at 12:00 p.m. EST. This is an explicit open solicitation, subject to the organization's bid documents and requirements.
why: Potential coverage across up to two Lowell shelter sites

items.title: Westfield State opened an RFP for advancement data modeling ahead of a fundraising campaign
items.description: Westfield State University's official open-bids page lists RFP 2027-002 for Advancement Data Modeling, with responses due September 25, 2026 through its electronic procurement platform. Public solicitation information describes the work as data-modeling services for Institutional Advancement ahead of a comprehensive fundraising campaign.
why: Official university bid page lists RFP 2027-002

items.title: Mount Wachusett Community College is procuring cloud accommodation-management software
items.description: Mount Wachusett Community College's official procurement page lists Accommodation Management Software RFP 27-01 as an open bid. Public RFP details describe a secure cloud platform integrated with Banner for accessibility requests, documentation, approvals and accommodation letters, plus implementation, data migration, training and support. A secondary public listing reports proposals due September 23, 2026; vendors should verify the exact deadline in the College's bid package because other aggregators show inconsistent dates.
why: Official college procurement page lists RFP 27-01 as open
Defined software, integration and implementation scope
items.sourceName: Mount Wachusett Community College / public RFP listing

items.title: Boston Public Health Commission is building a qualified consultant vendor pool across four service tracks
items.description: BPHC issued a single RFP to establish a pool of qualified consultants across Communications; Research, Evaluation and Assessment; Strategy and Planning; and Grant Writing. Qualified consultants may be engaged by BPHC programs and bureaus as project needs arise. Responses are due September 30, 2026 at 5:00 p.m.
why: Explicit RFP to establish a qualified consultant pool
items.sourceName: Boston Public Health Commission / City of Boston

items.title: Boston Region MPO is procuring AV design and installation for conference rooms and offices
items.business: Boston Region Metropolitan Planning Organization / Metropolitan Area Planning Council
items.description: The Metropolitan Area Planning Council, acting for the Boston Region MPO, issued COMMBUYS opportunity BD-27-1217-MAP05-MAP05-132666 for audiovisual assessment, design, installation, configuration, testing and support across conference rooms, offices and a meeting area. Responses are due September 30, 2026, with a remaining mandatory site-visit date listed before the deadline. This is an explicit technology procurement.
why: Multi-room AV design and installation scope
items.sourceName: Boston Region MPO / MAPC COMMBUYS listing via Govly

items.title: Gloucester opened an RFP for destination marketing organization services
items.description: The City of Gloucester is soliciting proposals under RFP #27025 for a Destination Marketing Organization. The City's official bid page lists the solicitation as open and states that proposals must be submitted electronically through BidNet Direct by September 15, 2026 at 11:00 a.m. This is an explicit marketing-services procurement.

items.title: P&G Gillette finalized the 232 A Street purchase for its new Boston headquarters and innovation center
items.description: Breakthrough Properties reported that the 232 A Street development site sale to P&G Gillette is finalized for a planned roughly 325,000-square-foot Grooming Headquarters and Technical Innovation Center. This is a concrete project milestone, but no specific vendor procurement is stated.

items.title: Community Teamwork is bidding laundry and linen cleaning services for a Lowell emergency shelter
items.description: Community Teamwork is publicly requesting bids for pickup, delivery and laundering of bedding, blankets, towels and kitchen linens supporting up to 60 individuals at an emergency shelter site. Bids are due September 11 at 12:00 p.m. EST. This is an explicit open solicitation.
why: Defined recurring service scope for up to 60 shelter guests

items.title: Community Teamwork is qualifying HEARTWAP heating, plumbing and asbestos contractors
items.description: Community Teamwork's RFP 26-28 seeks qualified contractors for heating-system repair and replacement, service calls, retrofits, related plumbing and asbestos-abatement services. The organization intends to establish an authorized-contractor list from which individual jobs may be awarded based on price quotes. Responses are due September 14 at 3:00 p.m. EST.
why: Selected contractors may receive individual jobs from an authorized-vendor pool

items.title: Amazon is seeking site-plan approval to launch Prime Air drone delivery from its Westborough facility
items.description: Westborough's Planning Board has scheduled a September 15 public hearing on application 26-02275, which requests a modification to an existing site-plan approval so Amazon can launch Prime Air drone delivery from its SMA1 facility at 64 Otis Street. This is an active permitting and digital-logistics project signal, not a vendor solicitation.
why: Specific public site-plan modification is under review
Project would launch Amazon Prime Air operations in Westborough
September 15 Planning Board hearing creates a concrete near-term milestone

items.title: Making Opportunity Count is seeking heating, asbestos and chimney contractors for HWAP work
items.description: A published legal notice states that Making Opportunity Count is seeking qualified contractors for heating-system service and installation, asbestos abatement and chimney services funded through its annual HWAP grant. Completed proposals are due September 18, 2026. Vendors should obtain the issuer's RFP packet for full requirements.
why: Public RFP notice with a September 18 deadline
Defined heating, asbestos and chimney work
Notice states an effort to utilize small, minority-owned, women-owned and labor-surplus-area firms
items.sourceName: Public Legal Notice / Making Opportunity Count, Inc.

items.title: Autonodyne is building a Boston autonomy demonstration center and expects to source most project work locally
items.description: Massachusetts awarded Autonodyne $1 million toward a roughly 6,500-square-foot demonstration laboratory and classroom in Boston. The state says the project includes IT, HVAC, simulators and related buildout, and that the company anticipates sourcing most project work from Massachusetts-based vendors. The announcement does not identify specific open vendor packages.
why: State announcement says most project work is expected from Massachusetts vendors
items.sourceName: Massachusetts Executive Office of Economic Development

items.title: Reframe Systems is opening a new Billerica microfactory after raising $40 million
items.description: Reframe Systems announced $40 million in new financing and said its FAB1 microfactory in Billerica will begin operations October 5. The company says the facility is designed for up to 500 multifamily units or 250 single-family homes annually with less than $5 million of equipment. No specific vendor solicitation is stated.

items.title: Miss A is entering Massachusetts with three stores, with two projects reported out to bid
items.description: Miss A's official store locator lists South Shore Mall in Braintree, North Shore Mall in Peabody and Auburn Mall as coming soon. The Connecticut Scoop additionally reports that the North Shore and South Shore locations are currently out to bid to area contractors for pricing. Public bid documents were not independently located, so the contractor-bid detail is treated as a reported signal rather than a confirmed open solicitation.
why: Three-store Massachusetts market entry is confirmed by the retailer
North Shore and South Shore projects are reported out to bid
Multi-site rollout creates repeatable fit-out opportunities
items.sourceName: Shop Miss A / The Connecticut Scoop

items.title: Healthpeak's Alewife Quadrangle PUD remains under review ahead of a September 15 Cambridge hearing
items.description: Cambridge Planning Board case PB-410 for Healthpeak's Alewife Quadrangle PUD remains under review with another hearing scheduled for September 15. City materials describe a large multi-phase mixed-use plan with roughly 2,300 residential units plus office/lab, retail and neighborhood uses. This is an active development-review signal, not an announced vendor procurement.
why: Planning Board case remains actively under review
Approximately 2,300 housing units plus substantial office/lab and retail scope
September 15 hearing provides a current project milestone

items.title: CPS Technologies leased an 80,000-square-foot Attleboro manufacturing facility
items.description: CPS Technologies signed a long-term lease for about 80,000 square feet in Attleboro and plans to relocate corporate offices, manufacturing and product development during 2027. A construction period runs through May 31, 2027; no specific vendor package is stated as open.

items.title: Nordstrom Rack is preparing its 23,700-square-foot Mansfield store for an October 29 opening
items.description: Nordstrom Rack's official openings page lists Mansfield Crossing for October 29, and Nordstrom Careers is actively recruiting for the new-store launch. Plymouth opened September 3, so this record focuses on the still-forward-looking Mansfield location. No local vendor solicitation is stated.
why: Active new-store recruiting confirms launch preparations

items.title: Synergy received a $4 million state award for the 294 Washington office-to-housing conversion
items.description: Massachusetts awarded $4 million in Commercial Conversion Tax Credits to Synergy for adaptive reuse of a historic Financial District office building into 255 rental homes and about 12,000 square feet of retail. The award is a concrete project milestone, not an open vendor solicitation.
items.sourceName: Massachusetts Executive Office of Housing and Livable Communities

items.title: STRONG Pilates is preparing three Greater Boston studios, with Back Bay and Fenway set for November 7
items.location: 10 Park Plaza and 650 Beacon Street, Boston, MA; 165 Main Street, Cambridge, MA
items.description: STRONG Pilates is entering Massachusetts with three Greater Boston studios. Fresh reporting says the Back Bay and Fenway locations are on track to open November 7, while the Kendall Square opening date is still to be announced. The multi-site launch creates plausible fit-out and operating-service needs, but no local vendor solicitation is stated.
why: Two studios have a specific November 7 opening date
Specialized connected fitness equipment and studio infrastructure

items.title: WinnCompanies launched a $41.5 million rehabilitation of Chicopee Village Townhomes
items.description: WinnCompanies acquired the 290-unit Chicopee Village Townhomes and launched a $41.5 million rehabilitation expected to run through summer 2028. Planned work includes roofs, windows, siding, paving, heating systems, apartment kitchens and bathrooms, accessibility upgrades and community-space modernization. No open subcontract package is stated.
why: Multiple specified building and infrastructure workstreams

items.title: Colleges of the Fenway is accepting business vendors for its September 11 Block Party
items.location: Emmanuel College Quad, 400 Fenway, Boston, MA
items.description: Colleges of the Fenway is offering vendor registration for its September 11 Block Party at Emmanuel College, a cross-campus event serving students from five member institutions. The official page lists a $200 vendor registration fee, with waived fees for nonprofits and possible in-kind arrangements for food or drink providers. This is an explicit promotional vendor opportunity, not a procurement contract.
why: September 11 event provides an immediate outreach window
Five-college consortium provides a concentrated student audience

items.title: Forman Mills is opening its first Springfield store on September 17
items.description: Forman Mills announced that it will open its first Springfield location on September 17. The large-format retail launch creates plausible site-service needs, but no local vendor solicitation is stated.

items.title: West Acton Oktoberfest is accepting visiting-vendor applications through September 9
items.description: The West Acton Village Merchants Association is publicly accepting visiting-vendor applications for its September 26 Oktoberfest. Applications and payment are due September 9. This is an explicit vendor opportunity subject to organizer approval and event rules.
why: September 26 event provides a defined selling window

items.title: The Posh Pup is seeking a special permit for a new commercial kennel in Maynard
items.description: The Maynard Planning Board posted notice of a September 22 public hearing on The Posh Pup LLC's application for a new special permit to authorize a commercial kennel at 94 Powder Mill Road in the Business District. This is an active permitting signal, not a vendor solicitation.
why: New commercial use at a specific address
September 22 hearing provides a current project milestone

items.title: MACDC is recruiting vendors and partners for its September 30 statewide Community Development Summit
items.business: Massachusetts Association of Community Development Corporations (MACDC)
items.description: MACDC is inviting vendors and partners to reserve tables at its September 30 Community Development Summit in Worcester, which it says will bring together more than 350 community-development professionals. The organizer specifically lists lenders, legal services, architecture and construction firms, technology providers, insurance, HR/payroll, grant-writing, energy-efficiency, printing and marketing providers among desired categories. This is a promotional vendor opportunity, not a procurement contract.
why: Organizer is explicitly recruiting vendors and partners
September 30 event targets more than 350 Massachusetts community-development professionals
Published vendor categories align with a broad range of B2B service providers
items.sourceName: Massachusetts Association of Community Development Corporations

items.title: Field Day Fall in Sharon is accepting vendor applications through September 10
items.business: New England Open Markets / Field Day Fall
items.location: Ward's Berry Farm, 614 South Main Street, Sharon, MA
items.description: New England Open Markets is accepting maker, artist, designer, vintage and antique vendor applications for Field Day Fall on September 27 at Ward's Berry Farm in Sharon. The current organizer page lists a September 10 application deadline, with rolling review until categories fill. This is an explicit event-vendor opportunity, not a procurement contract.
why: September 27 event provides a defined selling window
